kind: Data-derived: FlyWire v783 synapse counts from optic-lobe types that FlyVis models onto the circuit's visual projection neurons, by the presynaptic neuron's side (eye).
rule: weight = synapses from that type and eye ÷ the neuron's synapses from all mapped types; coverage = mapped synapses ÷ all of the neuron's input synapses in FlyWire v783
